events.title: Aberrate Inc. | New Announce Trailer & Publishing News!
events.summary: Hey everyone - it's a big day for Aberrate Inc.! We’re excited to finally share that "Aberrate Team" is now "Chilltop Games" and Aberrate Inc. is now being published by UK-based indie publisher Ripstone. To mark the occasion we’ve just released a brand new trailer! It’s a quick look at at N.T.R.N. and the cosy “thinky” puzzle vibe we’ve been quietly building towards since the game’s student‑project days!Aberrate Inc. started life at Macquarie University and went on to win Best Student Game at SX
